liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Morning Dew** (6 reviews): Jerry held a wrong note during the final crescendo, which unified the performance; Considered the best version of this song ever recorded, surpassing the Cornell performance [25][26][28][30][34][35]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Described as a truly remarkable performance that should not be overlooked by listeners [26]
- **When I Paint My Masterpiece** (1 review): Garcia's stunning vocal improvisation on a specific line at 8:23 is a special moment [32]
- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): Listed alongside Terrapin and Watchtower as standout moments of the concert [25]
- **All ALong The Watchtower** (1 review): Cited as the best version of this song, featuring Jerry going wild [28]
- **La Bamba** (1 review): The reviewer found Jerry's vocal performance on this track to be exceptional [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-09-18.sbd.finney.394.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 145 min; rated 4.83/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd87-09-18.sbd-healy-ultra-box.samaritano.21241.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 138 min; rated 4.2/5 by 5 [2]
- **gd1987-09-18.134825.sur5-1.tobin.flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 138 min [5]
- **gd1987-09-18.137535.sbd.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 141 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [10]
- **gd1987-09-18.sbd.bobh.10536.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 138 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [11]

## Around the show

- The performance from Space onwards was described as the best Grateful Dead experience [29]
- The crowd went wild when Jerry played a chordal improv at the end of Bird Song [34]
- Bobby urged the crowd to levitate Garcia as a goof on their Letterman appearance [5]
- Bobby urged the crowd to levitate Garcia as a joke referencing their Letterman appearance [10]
- Unlike Cornell, this show rocks front-to-back, though individual songs might be better elsewhere [30]
- The show lives up to the hype, prompting a question about why it is not a Dick's Pick [31]
- While beautiful and powerful, this Dew does not reach the heart-attack level of the Cornell version [33]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-09-18.sbd.finney.394.shnf**: transferred by D. Finney; source: Soundboard [1]
- **gd87-09-18.sbd-healy-ultra-box.samaritano.21241.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard (Healy Ultra Box)->Cassette Master. Cassette Master->HHb CDR-850 (pass-through only)->ZA2->.wav->mkw->SHN. Transfer and SHN by Joe Samaritano [2]
- **gd1987-09-18.134825.sur5-1.tobin.flac1648**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: flac16/48kHz ; 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound (48k) - SBD1 (shnid=134393) Set 1 SBD: ?? > CD > EAC > .wav > Flac; From Lisa Biasi collection. EAC > flac - Kevin Tobin… [5]. Also: 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound Mix created by an archive.org user, converted to FLAC in 2015 [5]
- **gd1987-09-18.137535.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) [10]. Also: Two sets of masters were used to complete the show, with pitch correction help [10]
- **gd1987-09-18.sbd.bobh.10536.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Dr. Goodseeds; source: sbd PCM > Dat x3 > wav > shn [11]. Also: Space patch uses SBD PCM to Cassette to DAT to WAV; Shakedown patch uses SBD to Cassette [11]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by wallpaperhdcornelia.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead Madison Square Garden](https://wallpaperhdcornelia.blogspot.com/2021/05/grateful-dead-madison-square-garden.html) [38]
